sentences.text: Chart scale is the ratio between a distance on the chart and the same distance on the earth.
A scale of one to forty thousand is larger than one to eighty thousand, because each inch covers less ground and shows more detail.
Remember: large scale, large detail, small area.

NOAA groups charts into sailing charts for offshore passages, general charts for coastwise navigation, coast charts for inshore work, harbor charts for harbors and anchorages, and small-craft charts, such as the strip charts that follow the Intracoastal Waterway.
Always use the largest-scale chart available for the waters you’re in.
